public_source_update.paper: Godin C, Thivierge J-P (2026), Manifold-constrained plasticity enables stable learning in recurrent neural circuits, PLOS Computational Biology, DOI 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1014719, published 2026-08-25
confirmed_from_public_article: SPLiT updates the empirical activity basis with Oja's rule and re-orthonormalizes the tracked subspace at every time step, described in the article text as 1 ms.
The MNIST tracing protocol presents one trajectory point per time step and also labels that time step as 1 ms.
The 2-Hz sine-wave task is trained for 10 seconds; S11 compares frozen versus adaptive tracked subspace and S12 applies 25-80 degree rotational perturbations.
The public article exposes S1 Code as DOI 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1014719.s002, but this invocation could not obtain the ZIP bytes through the available public transports.
public_source_update.preexisting_own_state_parameter_conflict: The prior role-local source recovery recorded Table 1 Delta t = 0.01 while the article prose says 1 ms for per-step orthonormalization/MNIST presentation. Official code remains the authority needed to resolve whether this is task-specific notation, a prose mismatch, or an implementation convention.

bounded_ambiguity_audit.purpose: Measure whether the unresolved 10 ms versus 1 ms timestep distinction can be safely ignored before official-code recovery.

shared_setup.network: constrained low-rank recurrent dynamics using a random orthonormal Q and W=Q W_k Q^T
audit_only_assumptions: External input was a random unit population vector multiplied by the 2-Hz target; the source-exact I(t) remains unknown until Code.zip inspection.
Tracked U began random orthonormal, decoder D began at zero, epsilon was set to 1e-6.
These assumptions are intentionally bounded and must not be called a reproduction of Fig.2, S11 or S12.

continuous_rate_interpretation.definition: Euler-integrate neural dynamics and multiply both Oja and decoder differential updates by dt.
continuous_rate_interpretation.interpretation: A 10x timestep change still moved this reduced audit, but the physical-time learning exposure stayed comparable because learning increments scale with dt.

per_step_learning_interpretation.definition: Euler-integrate neural state with dt but apply Oja and normalized-LMS learning increments once per simulation step without an extra dt factor.
per_step_learning_interpretation.interpretation: At fixed physical duration, 1 ms supplies 10x as many learning updates as 10 ms, producing a roughly 20.8x lower mean MSE in this audit. The timestep convention is therefore materially outcome-changing if eta_U/eta_D are implemented per step.

negative_scope: This audit does not test the source-exact external input, epsilon, initialization, noise scaling, update ordering or rotational-drift implementation.
The toy input directly contains the target and is therefore unsuitable for judging whether adaptive U is better than frozen U; method-ranking conclusions are explicitly forbidden from this audit.
Do not infer a paper error from the timestep sensitivity alone. The official code may resolve the apparent discrepancy through task-specific dt or explicit dt scaling.
bounded_ambiguity_audit.decision_relevant_inference: The source-level 10 ms versus 1 ms ambiguity cannot be treated as cosmetic before code inspection. In particular, whether eta_U and eta_D are physical-time rates or per-step increments changes effective learning exposure by an order of magnitude. Exact reproduction and fair matched baselines should wait for official-code resolution of dt and update scaling.

candidate_update.new_interpretation: Adaptive low-dimensional tracking remains an interesting mechanism, but the next highest-value uncertainty is implementation semantics rather than another unconstrained synthetic comparison. The official code must establish task-specific dt and whether Oja/decoder updates are dt-scaled before source-exact claims or effect-size comparisons are trusted.
scope: Prior reduced evidence that generic online PCA can match or beat Oja remains bounded to those reduced controls.
This run adds no evidence for or against the source paper's reported adaptive-versus-frozen advantage because the audit intentionally did not reproduce source I(t) or S11/S12.

exact_next_action: Recover the official PLOS S1 Code ZIP (DOI 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1014719.s002 / prior Figshare metadata article 33331919) through a file-capable public transport. Inspect the 2-Hz sine and rotational-drift scripts first for task-specific dt, whether U and D updates multiply dt, epsilon, initial U/D/r, I(t), noise scaling, update ordering, QR/re-orthonormalization frequency and seed handling. Then reproduce S11 or S12 source-exactly and add same-seed frozen-U, generic online-subspace plus identical coordinate-NLMS, full-space NLMS and tuned RLS/ridge/pseudoinverse controls. If ZIP retrieval remains blocked, derive two explicitly non-exact source-equation implementations that differ only in learning-rate time semantics and quantify which published qualitative claims are invariant to that choice.
